method: Manual API 35 emulator screenshot review; not pixel comparison or all-frame video analysis
findings: One-line Google emails, with intentional ellipsis for long addresses at 130% font scale
Calendar name displayed once per destination; account is a secondary line
Same-named calendars retain separate selectable identities and source accounts
Title, close button and selected indication remain visible in account and calendar pickers
Landscape dialog constrained to the actual window with a scrollable choice area
Final app and month widget show three titles plus +2 for five entries
Naver events and task entries remain lavender, Google entries remain green
Widget entry after background process death restores five stored schedules
limitations: No Galaxy hardware or authenticated cloud tests
All displayed calendars and events are isolated QA fixtures
